name: chronicle
description: Per-project persistent memory for any Claude agent.

userConfig.description: How much the plugin captures automatically. 'minimal' = only explicit saves; 'balanced' = significant events + explicit; 'aggressive' = all tool use.
Which events are considered significant enough to record. 'auto' = plugin decides; 'hybrid' = auto + explicit; 'explicit-only' = only manual saves.
Automatically write a session summary note when the session ends.
Record a lesson-candidate note whenever a Bash tool use fails.
Surface notes with upcoming due dates at the start of each session.
Warn when the vault exceeds this many notes. Set to 0 to disable. Run 'chronicle-write archive' to prune old session notes.
